securityBoundary: Backup/restore provider credentials must never enter repository evidence, ERP UI or public API.
Restore validation must use an isolated non-production fork/copy and record only non-secret provider metadata and integrity results.

Current Aiven documentation states service backups are encrypted and provider-managed; actual service/plan backup state still requires authorized provider read access and cannot be inferred from generic documentation.
inspection.observability: Provider backup status, retention/recovery window, restore operation state and post-restore database readiness are the causal observability required at N8.8.G.
inspection.rollback: Delete/retire the temporary restore verification resource after evidence capture; active Desarrollo database remains unchanged.
